mentions.name: Context-aware clipboard for Mac
mentions.description: This Mac app is a context-aware clipboard focused on notes, similar to Raycast but just for notes. Pressing control+option+C opens a window to save and describe content like webpages, project descriptions, images, and folders. Pressing control+option+V opens a Spotlight-like window with full-text search across all saved notes and descriptions, with options to open an item or insert its data into the current app such as Chrome, Slack, or ChatGPT.
mentions.audience: Switching between many apps to retrieve and copy/paste the same info, and forgetting about URLs saved in bookmarks.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m working on a context aware clipboard for Mac.

I found myself switching a lot between apps to get the same info, lots of copy/pasting.

Example, URLs in bookmark (which I forget about), project descriptions , images, folders.

So I built a Mac app that is similar to Raycast, but just for notes.
